<div class="card-body">
'''Dark Waters''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">よどみきった汚水</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の惑星上の屋外の位置に配備する。ただしホスは除く。あるいは、屋内のビークル位置カードに配備する。その場所では、敵によるフォース消耗は－1となる。このエフェクトは、同じ場所に沼沢地生物がいる場合には、「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Dark-Waters-PSA-161939285.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">沼地生まれの捕食生物は、じめじめとした猥雑な場所に潜んで音もなく忍びよる。「今、何かが足に触った！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stagnant filthy water.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any exterior location on a planet except Hoth. Or deploy on an interior vehicle location card. At that place, Force drains by the opponent are −1. If a swamp creature is at the same place, this Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
A swamp-born predator lurks in damp, filthy places and creeps up without a sound. “Something just touched my leg!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is よどみきった汚水 (stagnant filthy water).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dark Waters]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
